card.name: Joins before numbers and blood terms
card.fires_on: Small gaps or joiners just before a number or lab term: the space before page or count numbers in citations and statistics, and 'or' after 'monitor hemoglobin' before hematocrit.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A blank token just before a page range or large count in a citation or study summary.
modes.example: osteosarcoma of the extremity. N Engl J of Med 1986; 314(No.25):<< >>1600-160

modes.label: Hemoglobin or hematocrit
modes.description: The word 'or' linking hemoglobin to hematocrit in NSAID anemia warnings.
modes.example: has any signs or symptoms of anemia, monitor hemoglobin<< or>> hematocrit. NSAIDs, including

modes.label: Link in association statements
modes.description: 'and' between a drug class and a cancer in epidemiology sentences.
modes.example: combined oral contraceptives (COCs)<< and>> breast cancer risk. Studies do not show

card.plain: It fires on small joiners and spaces right before a number or a second blood test name.
